summary: Red Hill (Manker) lookout, San Bernardino County: built by the San Bernardino National Forest, opened 1937, renamed Manker 1939; now a private residence with no visits (NHLR).

facts.design: Unconventional lookout built to fit its surroundings; plans separated the residence from the lookout so visitors would not cross the living area
facts.agency: Privately held (built by the San Bernardino National Forest)

access.note: NHLR: the site is a private residence and no tours or visits are permitted

visit.trail_note: NHLR says no tours or visits are permitted at this private residence.

events.note: Opened July 17, 1937 per NHLR; a 1937 Sun dedication notice calls it the new Red Hill lookout. CBS LA says built in 1928, not reconciled
Renamed Manker Lookout on November 8, 1939, to honor fire chief Fletcher Manker
Family that had rented the building bought the property (NHLR); Peakbagging also gives 1975 for the private purchase. CBS LA gives a 1966 move-in instead
NHLR: the family added to the structure in 1982

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and the 1937 Sun dedication notice (as quoted by Forest Lookouts) give 1937. CBS LA, citing Cooper Museum staff, says built in 1928. The record uses 1937; the 1928 claim is not reconciled.
NHLR places it in the City of Rancho Cucamonga; the 1937 and 1939 Sun notices say northeast or east of Upland. The record keeps the NHLR city; both descriptions fit the same hill.
NHLR says a private party bought it and rented it out, with the family buying in 1975. CBS LA says the county sold it and a family moved in during 1966. Not reconciled.

notes_for_editor: The owner's name is left out of the story and the record; the CBS article names a private resident. The NHLR 'three-story' kind in the brief is not stated in any source read, so it is not recorded. No height is recorded. The 1928 vs 1937 build-year conflict and the 1966 vs 1975 occupancy conflict are not reconciled. CBS page carries no date. No access route for visitors exists: the site is a private residence. The Calisphere item returned no text and is not cited.
